text: 你和诺曼饥肠辘辘地走了许多天。一天早晨醒来，你发现诺曼不见了。你搜索了一整天，仍没发现他的任何踪迹。最终，你不得不承认自己孤身一人。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 295
text: The two of you walk, hungry, for many days. One morning you wake to find Norman gone. You search for the entire day but fail to turn up a single trace of him. In the end, you have to admit you are alone.
